definitions.gloss: crammed; packed; filling every inch of the space
definitions.explanation: Used almost only as {所狭|ところせま}しと, describing things laid out or people moving so that the whole space seems too small. A classical adjective ({狭|せま}し = {狭|せま}い) kept in a fixed phrase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所狭|ところせま}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Goods are lined up, filling every inch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{所狭|ところせま}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{積|つ}まれていた→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: Books were piled up all over the room.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{所狭|ところせま}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: The children are running all over the big park as if it were too small for them.

notes:
FORMS:
Almost always {所狭|ところせま}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb: ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧, ⟦{置|お}かれる→置く：01092_oku⟧, ⟦{飾|かざ}られる→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧, ⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧.

USAGE:
The literal sense is "the place is narrow." Used for a space packed with things, and for energetic movement across a space, as in a dancer moving {所狭|ところせま}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ across a stage.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぎっしり→ぎっしり：05891_gisshiri⟧: tightly packed — describes the contents, not the space
- ⟦びっしり→びっしり：05892_bisshiri⟧: densely covering a surface
